claims.text: Interstep attention can be incorporated into reasoning uncertainty quantification to analyze semantic correlations across steps.
A hidden confidence mechanism can retain historical confidence information across steps in long-horizon LLM responses.
Combining historical hidden confidence with stepwise confidence produces an overall uncertainty estimate for reasoning chains.

evidence.description: To address this issue, we propose a novel method that incorporates interstep attention to analyze semantic correlations across steps.
For handling long-horizon responses, we introduce a hidden confidence mechanism to retain historical confidence information...
...which is then combined with stepwise confidence to produce a more accurate overall estimate.

methodologies.name: Recurrent Confidence Chain
methodologies.description: A temporal-aware uncertainty quantification framework that uses interstep attention and a hidden confidence mechanism to track and integrate historical stepwise confidence in LLM reasoning sequences.

limitations.text: Existing sequence reasoning uncertainty methods overlook the temporal spread of confidence, leading to inflated overall confidence estimates even when earlier reasoning steps exhibit very low confidence.
